candidate.blueprint_locator: Basic Care and Comfort: provide nutrition and hydration interventions based on client needs; reinforce self-care measures that promote comfort and physiologic stability.
candidate.blueprint_topic: Basic Care and Comfort — hemodialysis fluid and sodium self-management
candidate.educational_objective: Teach clients on hemodialysis to count liquid-containing foods toward prescribed fluid intake and limit excess sodium because it increases thirst and contributes to fluid-management difficulty.

options.A: I will count foods that are liquid at room temperature, such as soup or gelatin, as part of my fluid intake and limit salty foods that increase thirst.
options.B: Ice cream and gelatin do not count as fluids because they are eaten with a spoon.
options.C: I can drink extra fluid whenever I do not have visible ankle swelling.
options.D: Eating more salty foods will help me tolerate the fluid restriction by reducing thirst.

candidate.rationale: NIDDK explains that excess fluid between hemodialysis treatments can contribute to swelling, blood-pressure changes, cardiac strain, and pulmonary fluid accumulation. Foods that are liquid at room temperature—including soup, gelatin, pudding, and ice cream—contribute to fluid intake. NIDDK also notes that salt increases thirst, so limiting sodium can help clients control fluid intake. Therefore A is correct. B excludes foods that count as fluid, C uses absence of edema as an unsafe substitute for the prescribed plan, and D reverses the sodium-thirst relationship.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Hemodialysis fluid-management teaching includes counting foods that contribute liquid and limiting excess sodium because salt increases thirst and excess fluid can cause clinically important complications.
candidate.source_locator: Why is it important to keep track of how much liquid I eat or drink?: excess fluid consequences and individualized fluid limits; salt makes clients thirsty. What foods count as liquid and why?: foods liquid at room temperature such as soup, gelatin, pudding and ice cream count toward fluid intake.
candidate.source_organization: National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (NIDDK), NIH
candidate.stem: A client receiving hemodialysis has been prescribed a fluid restriction. Which statement shows correct understanding of fluid-management teaching?
